event.summary: The 71st Eurovision Song Contest is set to take place in Burgas, a port city on Bulgaria's Black Sea coast. This decision follows the victory of Bulgarian singer Dara in this year's contest.

timeline.title: Dutch Broadcaster AVROTROS to Boycott Eurovision 2027 Over Neutrality Concerns
timeline.summary: Dutch broadcaster AVROTROS has announced its decision to boycott the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest, citing concerns that the event can no longer be considered neutral due to escalating international conflicts, particularly the war in Gaza. This marks the second time the Netherlands has opted out of the competition for similar reasons.
key_facts: AVROTROS will not participate in Eurovision 2027.
The decision is in protest of Israel's participation amid the Gaza conflict.
The broadcaster claims the event is no longer neutral.

event_overview.title: About the Eurovision Song Contest
event_overview.subject: Eurovision Song Contest
event_overview.summary: The Eurovision Song Contest is an annual international live music competition in which participating public-service broadcasters select performers and songs to represent them. It is organized under the auspices of the European Broadcasting Union (EBU) and combines live televised performances with a competitive voting process to determine a winner.

facts.label: Origins
facts.value: The first Contest was held in Switzerland on May 24, 1956, with seven participating nations.

facts.label: Governing framework
facts.value: The Contest is an international co-production by EBU Members, carried out under the auspices of the European Broadcasting Union as part of the Eurovision television-programme exchange.

facts.label: Participation model
facts.value: Participating public-service broadcasters—not national governments directly—enter artists and songs; in the 2026 edition, 35 broadcasters were confirmed as competitors.

facts.label: Competition format
facts.value: The modern Contest normally uses two Semi-Finals and a Grand Final; countries that qualify from the Semi-Finals join the previous year’s winner and the ‘Big Five’ broadcasters in the Final.

facts.label: 2027 edition
facts.value: The 71st Eurovision Song Contest is scheduled for Burgas, Bulgaria, at Arena Burgas, with Semi-Finals on May 11 and May 13, 2027, and the Grand Final on May 15; it will be hosted by Bulgarian National Television (BNT) with the EBU.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline covers the August 2026 announcement of Burgas as 2027 host and AVROTROS’s stated decision not to participate; it does not provide a complete record of entrants, rules, production arrangements, or all political and broadcaster developments surrounding the Contest.
